# Aback UI

> Aback UI is an open-source React component library and design system from Aback Group. It installs by copying source through a shadcn-compatible registry. Components use a neutral square-corner design language, the Aback Blue brand ramp, and semantic CSS tokens with light and dark themes.

- Website: https://abackui.com
- Registry: https://abackui.com/r/{name}.json
- License: MIT
- Status: pre-1.0; APIs may change before the first stable release

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://abackui.com/docs): what Aback UI is and how it is built
- [Installation](https://abackui.com/docs/installation): add the theme and install a component
- [Components](https://abackui.com/docs/components): the component catalogue
- [Theming](https://abackui.com/docs/theming): semantic tokens, light and dark, brand overrides
- [Design tokens](https://abackui.com/docs/tokens): color roles, type, spacing, geometry
- [Registry](https://abackui.com/docs/registry): source-copy format and commands
- [Accessibility](https://abackui.com/docs/accessibility): keyboard model and verification status
- [Built with Aback UI](https://abackui.com/built-with): the Aback products that shaped the components

## Install

```
npx shadcn@latest add https://abackui.com/r/button.json
```

Then import the theme once in your global stylesheet:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "./styles/aback.css";
```

## Component index

Accordion, Alert, Badge, Breadcrumbs, Button, Card, Checkbox, Dialog, Dropdown Menu, Empty State, Field, Input, Kbd, Label, Page Header, Select, Separator, Skeleton, Spinner, Switch, Table, Tabs, Textarea, Tooltip.

Each component page documents its API, keyboard behavior, and accessibility notes.
